battle.name: Battle
battle.blurb: The horde holds this ground. Expect to be outnumbered.

ambush.name: Ambush

scout.name: Lookout

village.name: Abandoned village
village.blurb: Empty homes. Something useful may remain.

objective.name: Last stand
objective.blurb: Where the company makes its stand against the host.

CAMPAIGNS.name: The Hillsvain Host
CAMPAIGNS.blurb: A host of orcs and goblins is pouring out of the Hillsvain Woods, burning every steading west of the Vattern. The Margrave's riders are days away. March out, slow the horde, and hold Brannsted until they come: you are all that stands between the host and the river.

hints.terrain: Forest glades, the Vattern and its ford, burning farmsteads, the walls of Brannsted.
hints.length: Short: about five marches, then the last stand.
hints.threat: Always outnumbered. Waves of goblins, wolf riders on the flanks, brutes that smash lines, and the warchief himself at the end.
hints.supplies: Bring rations for every march and plenty of bolts: the last stand is long. Bandages save the fallen.

objective.name: Brannsted
objective.description: Hold the steading of Brannsted against the whole host until the Margrave's riders arrive at dawn, or slay its warchief.
